hooks.name: Git Push Secrets Check
hooks.description: Prevents git push if .gitignore doesn't properly exclude secrets

action.command: echo '{"event":"pre-push","hook":"pre-push-secrets-check"}' | node -e "const data = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8')); const fs = require('fs'); const gitignore = fs.readFileSync('.gitignore', 'utf8'); const secretsToCheck = ['.env', '.secrets/', '00-Private/', '*_secret*', '*_private*']; const violations = []; if (gitignore) { secretsToCheck.forEach(pattern => { if (pattern.includes('*')) { const regex = new RegExp(pattern.replace(/\*/g, '.*').replace(/_/g, '\\_')); if (!gitignore.match(regex)) violations.push(pattern); } else if (!gitignore.includes(pattern)) violations.push(pattern); }); } if (violations.length > 0) { console.error('ERROR: Git ignore rules missing patterns: ' + violations.join(', ')); console.error('Please update .gitignore to include: ' + violations.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✅ .gitignore properly configured'); process.exit(0); }"
